scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @claudio/web build && pnpm --filter @claudio/api bundle && pnpm run build && electron . --dev --no-sandbox
scripts.package:stage: mkdir -p dist/package && node ../api/scripts/server-bundle.mjs --shell-json dist/package/shell.json && install -m 0644 ../../packaging/apt/claudio-archive-keyring.gpg dist/package/claudio-archive-keyring.gpg
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm --filter @claudio/web build && pnpm --filter @claudio/api bundle && pnpm run build && pnpm run package:stage && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
